# wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml (Resource)

Provides a SAML external authentication resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml" "corporate_saml" {
  authentication_name = "corporate_saml"
  idp_metadata        = file("${path.module}/idp-metadata.xml")
  timeout             = 30
  description         = "Corporate SAML identity provider"

  claim_customization {
    username    = "email"
    displayname = "name"
    email       = "email"
    language    = "locale"
    group       = "groups"
  }
}
```

### With a Service Provider Signing Certificate

```terraform
resource "wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml" "signed_saml" {
  authentication_name = "signed_saml"
  idp_metadata        = file("${path.module}/idp-metadata.xml")
  timeout             = 30
  certificate         = file("${path.module}/sp-certificate.pem")
  private_key         = file("${path.module}/sp-private-key.pem")
  passphrase          = var.sp_private_key_passphrase

  claim_customization {
    username = "email"
  }
}
```

## Usage Notes

### claim_customization Is Required

`claim_customization` maps SAML assertion attributes from the identity provider to Bastion user
fields. Only `username` is required within the block; `displayname`, `email`, `language`, and
`group` are optional and should match the attribute names your identity provider sends in its
SAML assertions.

This block, and the whole resource, requires Bastion API v3.12+ - it is not available on API
v3.8.

### Service Provider Metadata

Once created, the resource exposes computed attributes describing the Bastion side of the SAML
exchange - `sp_entity_id`, `sp_metadata`, `sp_assertion_consumer_service`, and
`sp_single_logout_service` - which are typically needed to configure the identity provider to
trust the Bastion. `idp_entity_id`, `saml_request_url`, and `saml_request_method` describe the
identity provider side, parsed from `idp_metadata`.

### Signing Certificate Is Optional

`certificate`, `private_key`, and `passphrase` configure a certificate the Bastion uses to sign
its own SAML requests. They're optional - omit all three if the identity provider doesn't require
signed requests. `passphrase` requires `private_key` to also be set.

## Import

SAML external authentication can be imported using its `authentication_name`, e.g.

```shell
terraform import wallix-bastion_externalauth_saml.corporate_saml corporate_saml
```
